name: Cubing Is Back Raipur 2022

venue.name: Club Paraiso
venue.address: Maruti Lifestyle, Parmanand Nagar, Kota, Raipur, Chhattisgarh

information: **Participants have to bring their own cube for the event.** There will be no On-the-spot (OTS) registration.The fees structure is variable as per information given in the [Registration and Payments Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingIsBackRaipur2022#16737-registrations-payments.) Please note once you register in WCA site for the Cubing Is Back Raipur 2022, your name will be in waiting list and once your payment is done then your name will appear in competitors list within 1-2 days. All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except New comers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to Judge (or) Scramble for the entire event, all this will be decided by the organising team and will be informed 2 days before the event, we will make sure that your volunteering will not affect your main events and participation. We will be dividing all the particiapants into groups and will be giving you a time slot during which one and come and particpate in all events and all this information will be send to you through email once we finish all the registration. ***Quick Info links:*** [**Event Schedule**](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingIsBackRaipur2022#competition-schedule) **[Payment Details](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingIsBackRaipur2022#16737-registrations-payments)**
